key_fields.name: TRAN-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 350-byte posted transaction record (comment RECLN 350; field sizes add up to 350).

key_fields.name: TRAN-ID
key_fields.meaning: 16-byte transaction id, key of the transaction file; CBACT04C builds it from the run date and a 6-digit sequence.

key_fields.name: TRAN-TYPE-CD
key_fields.meaning: 2-character transaction type code (CBACT04C uses '01' for interest).

key_fields.name: TRAN-CAT-CD
key_fields.meaning: 4-digit transaction category code (CBACT04C uses 5 for interest).

key_fields.name: TRAN-SOURCE
key_fields.meaning: 10-byte origin of the transaction (e.g. 'System' for interest).

key_fields.name: TRAN-MERCHANT-ID
key_fields.meaning: 9-digit merchant id, with merchant name, city and ZIP following.

key_fields.name: TRAN-CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Card number the transaction is charged to.

key_fields.name: TRAN-ORIG-TS
key_fields.meaning: 26-byte origination timestamp (DB2 format YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.nnnnnn in CBACT04C).

purpose: CVTRA05Y defines TRAN-RECORD, the 350-byte posted transaction entity: id, type and category codes, source, description, amount, merchant details, card number and origination/processing timestamps. It is written by CBACT04C (interest) and CBTRN02C (posting), read by reporting and migration programs (CBTRN03C, CBEXPORT, CBIMPORT) and by online programs COBIL00C, CORPT00C, COTRN00C, COTRN01C and COTRN02C.
